# Brooklyn Org

> Brooklyn Org is a philanthropic organization supporting nonprofit partnerships focused on civil rights, community advocacy, and social justice initiatives across Brooklyn and New York State.

Brooklyn Org partners with organizations like the Asian American Federation and Surveillance Technology Oversight Project (S.T.O.P.) to address critical issues including anti-Asian hate, surveillance oversight, privacy protection, and community empowerment. The organization is based in Fort Greene, Brooklyn, and supports initiatives ranging from mental health services to technology accountability.

## Key Topics

- Asian American Federation (AAF)
- Surveillance Technology Oversight Project (S.T.O.P.)
- Civil rights advocacy
- Privacy protection and surveillance oversight
- Anti-Asian hate response
- Community advocacy
- Nonprofit partnerships
- Social justice education
- Technology accountability
- Mental health support
- Small business support
- Facial recognition oversight
- NYPD accountability
- Pandemic response
- Fort Greene, Brooklyn

## Nonprofit Partnerships

- [Asian American Federation](https://brooklyn.org/asian-american-federation): Brooklyn Org's partnership supporting Asian American Federation's advocacy
- [S.T.O.P. - Surveillance Technology Oversight Project](https://brooklyn.org/surveillance-technology-oversight-project): Brooklyn Org backing S.T.O.P.'s surveillance oversight and civil rights work

## Social Justice Initiatives

- [Jessie Streich-Kest Memorial Fund](https://brooklyn.org/jessie-streich-kest-memorial-fund): Memorial scholarship fund for Brooklyn students in social justice education
